description: Providers ranked by how far below or above the market their prices are: each provider's median gap to the market, in percent (score_pct, negative when below the market), where the market of a model is the median blended 3:1 price of its providers, counted only on models with at least min_providers comparable providers (models_measured). Also the number of models where the provider holds the offer the cheapest tool would select (cheapest_count). Ranked from min_models models measured; refreshed every hour.
name: provider_ranking
title: Providers ranked by price gap
